agentGuide: Pi-hole v6 API, base path /api. Numbers: GET /api/stats/summary (queries, clients, gravity); top lists: GET /api/stats/top_domains?blocked=true, /api/stats/top_clients; recent queries: GET /api/queries?length=50 (&domain=, &client=). Blocking: GET /api/dns/blocking; POST /api/dns/blocking {"blocking": false, "timer": 300} pauses it for five minutes. Lists: GET /api/domains (allow/deny, exact/regex); add: POST /api/domains/deny/exact {"domain": "ads.example.com"}; delete: DELETE /api/domains/deny/exact/<domain>. Adlists: GET /api/lists; update gravity: POST /api/action/gravity. Version: GET /api/info/version. The session id is set by Allkin.
